fact: The 4 August 2025 notice states that programmes in Cameroon each run their own targeting and data storage, and that a RESUC information system with a data management and interoperability module, interoperable with other information systems, is being procured.
title: Avis a sollicitation des manifestations d'interet N°005/ASMI/MINEPAT/CTS/PFS-AIE/UGP/2025 du 04 aout 2025: SIG du RESUC
publisher: Projet Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et d'Inclusion Economique (UGP), published by ARMP
